observations.tone: No shaming, punishment, urgency, comparison with other children, or threat was identified in the title/hint pools. “Bắt lỗi” describes puzzle/robot errors, not a child’s worth. These observations do not certify all product copy.
observations.age: Young hints are short and generally concrete (max 62 rendered characters); older hints offer comparison and rule-testing strategies (max 104). Differences alone do not establish age usability. Some older terms (phần tử, ứng viên, tổ hợp, trục) require reading familiarity.
observations.answerLeakage: No obvious exact answer, candidate/option ID, solution coordinate or answer label is inserted by these hint templates. target/max/trait are already-visible task parameters. Naming a board mode (removed/added/flip) narrows the task, but does not identify its answer. This is semantic/template inspection, not a proof against every inference or all renderer/board interactions.
observations.titleThemes: Chapter names are story framing; the boards do not always literally depict the chapter. Do not infer a promised illustrated scene from title variety.

remainingGaps: No sequential manual reading of all 1278 full composed title strings; compositional inspection and exact frame verification are the stated method.
